title: Rory and the Soft Amber Grove
verses:
The amber sun dipped down low in the west,
And Rory decided it was time to rest.
The breeze in the branches sang softly and slow,
While warm little fireflies started to glow.

Then Psittaco chirped from a blanket of leaves,
As Nia swooped down through the cozy green trees.
They watched as the stars came to light up the deep,
And called to their friends it was time for some sleep.

Then Benny stretched out on the soft mossy ground,
While Tilly relaxed without making a sound.
They made a warm circle so cozy and sweet,
Where all of the dynos could rest their tired feet.

And Ricky curled up with a tiny soft sigh,
As pale silver moonbeams slid down from the sky.
Then Rory tucked in near his friends for the night,
Wrapped up in the glow of the sweet starry light.

The night was so quiet, the breezes were still,
As darkness rolled over the high sleepy hill.
The shadows were gentle, the forest was calm,
Wrapped up in the evening's most comforting balm.

Now Rory was snoring a gentle deep hum,
For peaceful sweet dreams had officially come.
So close your eyes softly and nestle in tight,
To Rory and friends, we will whisper goodnight.
